proposal.reason: Main change is in **network**: proxy progress batching/abort-aware control and intra-node NET selection behavior are updated. **device-topology** is additionally needed because PATH_NET and GPU↔NET path computation/trimming/cleanup semantics are introduced to drive that decision. **transport** is additionally needed because P2P/SHM canConnect policy is substantively changed to yield to the new NET-vs-local path check.
